props.gloss_en: the baraita: [in the bathhouse] there is no greeting there

Rav: it is permitted to say 'faithfulness' in the privy
(denied) 'faithfulness' is itself a name of God -- there, the Name itself is not called so, as we render [the verse] 'the faithful God' (אלהא מהימנא)
here the Name itself is called Shalom, as it is written 'and he called it: the Lord is Shalom'
